name: inkwell-hooks
description: Nudges Claude Code / Codex to actually use the Inkwell MCP memory server — search before starting work, and search before remembering.

interface.shortDescription: Nudges agents to actually use the Inkwell MCP memory server
interface.longDescription: Mechanically enforces the Inkwell memory workflow instead of relying on the model to self-police it: blocks `remember` until a `search`/`recall` has run this session and reminds to search at session start. Installable in both Claude Code and Codex from the same manifest.
